title: TrackAI Attesta ai-provenance predicate v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT (Task15c). Predicate type https://trackai.dev/attesta/ai-provenance/v1. Closed object: every field is required and carries availability. Numbers are integers within +/-(2^53-1). No raw prompts, responses, code, diffs, commit messages, titles, branch names, file paths, emails or names. See README.md.

metric_event.description: telemetry_metric_events row the observation came from (commit_observed).

note_digest.description: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the Git AI authorship note string as decoded from the source metric event (the string Task2 stores in scm_commits.authorship_note), with no normalization.

url_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of the normalized repository URL (scm_repositories.normalized_url). The URL itself is never included.

unknown_lines.description: Task2 does not compute per-file unknown lines today: unavailable in v1.

calculation_version.description: Task2 publishes no calculation version yet (gap G6): unavailable in v1; builder.version pins the code.

org_ai_policy.description: Organization AI-usage policy (Task6.b, gap G2): unavailable in v1.

security_findings_observed.description: Monitor-only Task6 findings observed in the sessions behind this subject. Observed, never blocked or prevented.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds and Z (Date.prototype.toISOString form).

token.description: Bounded identifier: no whitespace, at most 128 characters, no email-like "@host.domain" ("model@20241022" is allowed). Free text (titles, messages, code) cannot fit.

delivery_ref.description: A provider delivery GUID (hex and dashes), or the hash fallback.

external_ref.description: A numeric provider ID (PR, deployment), or the hash fallback.

availability_rules.description: recorded: value only. partial: value and partial_reason. unavailable: reason only, never a value (so never a zero).
